summary: Sony Group Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing a share repurchase facility and treasury stock cancellation. The board authorized the open-market repurchase of up to 230 million shares (3.89% of outstanding) for a maximum of ¥500 billion through May 10, 2027, via a discretionary trading contract. Additionally, Sony will cancel 184,494,319 treasury shares (3.0% of outstanding) on May 29, 2026. The repurchase aims to improve capital efficiency and offset dilution from stock compensation plans. Sony revised its prior policy to hold treasury stock for future equity awards and cancel excess. The plan is flexible—no minimum repurchase—and no advisors were named. Watch actual buyback pace as a signal of management's capital allocation conviction.
